caption: The average price PER COLOR — one row per distinct color.

code:
-- ERROR: Name isn't aggregated, isn't in GROUP BY
SELECT Name, Color, AVG(ListPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY Color;
caption: Multiple names share a Color group — there's no single Name to show.
